intro hs
have h_encard : (⋃ i, s i).encard = ∑ᶠ (i : ι), (s i).encard :=
  by
    let encard_union := (⋃ i, s i).encard
    let sum_encard := ∑ᶠ (i : ι), (s i).encard
    have h_disjoint : Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint s) := hs
    have h_nonempty : ∀ i, (s i).Nonempty :=
      by intro i; exact Set.Nonempty.intro ⟨⟩
    have h_injective : Function.Injective fun s => ⋃ i ∈ s, s i :=
      Pairwise.biUnion_injective h_disjoint h_nonempty
    have h_sigma_set : Set.range ⇑(Function.Embedding.sigmaSet h_disjoint) = ⋃ i, s i :=
      Function.Embedding.sigmaSet_range h_disjoint
    have h_sigma_set_eq : Set.range ⇑(Function.Embedding.sigmaSet h_disjoint) = ⋃ i, s i :=
      h_sigma_set
    have h_encard_eq_sum :=
      by
        rw [h_sigma_set_eq]
        apply encard_sigma_set
        exact h_disjoint
    rw [h_encard_eq_sum]
    exact rfl
  h_encard
